title: noisemap output, version 2
description: The JSON written by `noisemap <dir>` and printed by `noisemap <dir> --json`. This is the contract renderers depend on; the analyzer bumps `version` on any incompatible change.

root.description: Absolute path of the analyzed directory. Module paths are relative to it, POSIX separators.

detected.description: Frameworks named in the nearest package.json's dependencies.

adapters.description: Adapter ids that produced at least one module.

userConfig.description: Absolute path of the noisemap.config.json that was applied, or null.

tokenizer.description: Plain-language statement of the counting unit.

consistency.description: Mean Euclidean distance of each module's share vector from the median shape of its family (its dominant bucket). 0 = every kind of module has one shape, whether four clean shapes or one shared mixed shape; max √2.

median.description: Component-wise median of every module's share vector, for reference. Consistency is not measured against it.

shares.description: Bucket share of all counted tokens in the codebase.

meanMixing.description: Unweighted mean of module mixing: every module counts once.

families.description: One entry per dominant bucket that has at least one module.

meanMixingTokenWeighted.description: Token-weighted mean of module mixing: every counted token counts once, so large modules dominate.

codeModules.description: The headline mixing figure: mean module mixing over code modules, everything but stylesheets (.css, .scss, .sass, .less), so the score does not depend on how a framework files its styles (2026-09-29). Null with no code modules.

byOperation.description: The same code modules read by operation alone, every structural ruling off: no sanctioned-member sealing, no trait absorption, no export sealing, no host inheritance for a payload filter or a transmit. Reported beside the headline so a reader can see whether the ranking depends on the rulings (2026-09-29). Null with no code modules.

shape.description: Declared-shape counts (2026-09-27). `declared` modules have a role; `insideShape` keep every token inside what the role expects or permits (drift 0); `withSurface`/`onSurface` count modules whose role sanctions a member set and how many define nothing outside it. `undeclared` modules have no role and cannot be asked either question; `internalModules`/`internalSurfaces` count the ones with a visible internal surface (components) and how many distinct surfaces they show.

modules.description: One entry per accepted file with at least one counted token, sorted by path.

empty.description: Accepted files with zero counted tokens. Excluded from every score.

byExtension.description: Keyed by lower-cased extension with dot, or `(none)`.

tests.description: Test files left out (directories test, tests, __tests__, __mocks__, __snapshots__; files *.test.* and *.spec.*). 0 when --include-tests was given. Not part of `count`.

failed.description: Accepted files the adapter could not analyze (parse errors). In no score.

directories.description: Per-directory rollups of the codebase scores, one row per directory holding a module, ancestors included; `.` is the root.

excluded.description: Scaffolding and comments. Not part of any share.

start.description: Character offset into the file, inclusive.

rule.description: The rule that assigned this span, e.g. `scaffolding`, `comment`, `method:addActionListeners`, `content:scss`.

tokens.description: Tokens in the span that carry its bucket and rule.

punctuation.description: Punctuation tokens absorbed into the span. Always excluded; never in a share.

permitted.description: Every token in the span sits outside the module's expected shape but is permitted there by a rule (a trait call in a Channel, a transmit from a view trait). In place, not drift.

misplaced.description: Every token in the span sits in a member the role does not sanction (a method of its own on a ViewStream): out of place whatever its bucket, and drift (2026-09-29).

framework.description: Adapter id that analyzed the file: react, spynejs, content.

role.description: Declared role from a config match rule, e.g. ViewStream. Absent when none.

spans.description: Adjacent same-bucket, same-rule tokens merged, absorbing punctuation between them. Covers every token in source order; whitespace gaps are not covered. Sum of tokens + punctuation over spans = every token in the file.

drift.description: Share of counted tokens outside the role's expected shape, less permitted tokens. Present only when `role` is.

logicInRendering.description: Logic tokens whose innermost rendering range is a JSX element: evaluation inside markup. A template section iterates and evaluates nothing, so a .html module reports 0 by grammar.

expected.description: The buckets the declared role expects, host-bound when the role declares hosts. Present only when `role` is.

base.description: The role's default bucket: the color the module is, for every token in its place. Present only when `role` is.

mixingByOperation.description: The module's mixing read by operation alone, the per-module counterpart of `scores.byOperation`. Code modules only (2026-09-29).

bindings.description: For a trait: the host classes that bind it through `props.traits`, with their kind, as the adapter read them. Shows why a shared trait absorbs both layers (2026-09-29).

surface.description: Members defined against the sanctioned surface. `sanctioned` is null for a module with no role; `members` is then the internal surface the tool could see (hooks called, handlers defined).

modules.description: Modules whose largest share is this bucket.

median.description: Component-wise median shape of those modules.
